qualificationNotes: Setup gives resource creation and provider registration capabilities, or coordination with their holder, not a unique least-privileged custom role. Subscription Contributor and Owner are examples, not universal Owner requirements.

The setup page does not publish an exhaustive subscription-offer eligibility list. Cost-access agreement conditions do not establish PAYG eligibility; actual same-tenant active subscription and supported selection still need customer confirmation.
Current setup filters environments by Region. The reviewed text does not establish all cross-region combinations; do not invent region matching between resource-group metadata and an environment.
The 2026-10-14 meter page identifies Copilot Credits; older overview/usage prose still says messages. The article uses the current product meter unit and flags legacy report wording.

The current billing-licensing page is explicitly standard-harness scoped. Its maker-access options are not generalized to all Copilot Studio runtime experiences; the older license-assignment page is a selected route, not a requirement to buy prepaid capacity for all PAYG makers.
Current FAQ and meters allow Dataverse capacity allocation and list Process license restrictions. The article does not repeat older blanket storage-pooling or unlimited-request claims.
Azure reporting up to 24 hours and new-subscription cost features up to 48 hours are documentation windows, not measured customer guarantees.
All main setup steps expose prerequisites, executor/permission scope, action/location, success and missing-permission/visibility checks outside optional accordions.
unresolvedCustomerChecks: Actual subscription offer/provider and picker eligibility
Tenant-specific UI availability and any product preview/contract conditions
Organizational approval, real role assignments, selected environments, cost policy, and replacement licensing
